name: ESAF Small Finance Bank
summary: ESAF Small Finance Bank provides banking products and services to rural and semi-urban markets in India. The company operates through four segments: Treasury, Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations. It offers savings and current accounts; fixed, recurring, green, and FCNR deposits; debit and credit cards; and home, gold, vehicle, MSME, Agri, clean energy, QR, and micro finance and micro loans, as well as loan against property, and financial institution lending. The company also provides payment products, such as Bharat bill payment system and BHIM unified payment interface; and investment products, including life insurance, health insurance, general insurance, demat,…
